FULL TEXT:
Panjab University Constituent College Sikhwala
Distt. Sri Muktsar Sahib (Punjab India) Tel. +91 1637-285088
Walk-in-Interview
Walk-in-Interview for the appointment of Guest Faculty in the subject of Punjabi for teaching
B.A./M.A. classes for the session 2023-24 will be held on 22/07/2023 at Panjab University Constituent
College, Sikhwala, Distt. Sri Muktsar Sahib.
The eligible candidates are requested to report Panjab University Constituent College, Sikhwala,
Distt. Sri Muktsar Sahib at 10:00 a.m. sharp on 22/07/2023. No candidate will be considered after the
stipulated time. Interview will be started at 12:00 noon sharp
Qualifications: As per Panjab University/UGC norms.
All the applicants (Who are eligible as per UGC/PU norms are advised to bring their original
certificates and other relevant documents including publications with photo copies of certificates and 02
passport photographs) for verification along with duly filled forms giving the details at the time of
interview.
No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
Form can be downloaded from the website https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php
Dr. Iqbal Singh Sandhu
Principal
(098159-17828)
